name: wimsta-mcp
description: MCP server with 17 evidence-based body and fitness calculators: BMI, body fat %, BMR, TDEE, ideal weight, protein, water, max heart rate, VO2max, one-rep max, running pace and more, as honest ranges across published formulas, plus the open WIMSTA formula registry. No API key.

tools.name: bmi
tools.description: BMI range: classic Quetelet + Trefethen "new BMI", WHO category

tools.name: body_fat
tools.description: Body-fat % range across Deurenberg, CUN-BAE, US Navy, RFM, Covert Bailey, Gallagher category

tools.name: bmr
tools.description: Basal metabolic rate range: Mifflin-St Jeor, Harris-Benedict 1984/1919, WHO/FAO, Katch-McArdle

tools.name: tdee
tools.description: Maintenance calories (TDEE) range for an activity level

tools.name: max_heart_rate
tools.description: Max heart rate range across nine formulas + five training zones

tools.name: waist_to_height
tools.description: Waist-to-height ratio, Ashwell zone, healthy waist range

tools.name: ideal_weight
tools.description: Ideal body weight range across seven classic formulas + WHO healthy-weight range

tools.name: ffmi
tools.description: Fat-Free Mass Index, raw and normalized, neutral band

tools.name: body_surface_area
tools.description: Body surface area range across eight formulas

tools.name: body_shape
tools.description: Body-shape type from bust, waist and hip ratios

tools.name: body_frame
tools.description: Body-frame size from the height / wrist ratio

tools.name: protein
tools.description: Daily protein bands (RDA, active, preservation, lean-mass)

tools.name: water
tools.description: Daily water range across five authorities, lifestyle add-ons

tools.name: one_rep_max
tools.description: One-rep max range across Epley, Brzycki, Lombardi, Lander + training table

tools.name: vo2max
tools.description: VO2max range from Uth, Cooper and Rockport field tests

tools.name: running_pace
tools.description: Pace / time / distance solver + Riegel race prediction range

tools.name: get_formula
tools.description: One formula from the open WIMSTA formula registry (CC BY 4.0): equation, citation, validation population, limitations

tools.name: list_formulas
tools.description: Registry index, or all formulas of a category
